about_the_game:
Alone in a world recovering from a magical dark age, you arrive in a quiet land where magic is slowly returning, and an illness spreads through the remnants of a once-thriving world. In search of a place to call home, you set out to rebuild and restore balance to the land.

Your task is to cleanse corrupted elemental crystals scattered throughout the world. As you purify these crystals, magic and hope return, bringing you closer to your ultimate goal: finding a sanctuary in this new world.

In your journey, you'll build a home. Choose the perfect spot to settle, gather resources, and unlock ways to customize your space, creating a personal refuge. With each step of progress, your home becomes a symbol of the life you’re beginning to create.

But you’re not entirely alone. Robert, a talking frog, becomes your first companion, guiding you through the land and offering comfort along the way. Through fishing, camping, and conversations, your bond with Robert grows, helping you heal and find your place in this world.

name: Twilight Traveller
short_description: Discover where you belong in this cozy, relaxing top-down adventure RPG. Befriend a talking frog named Robert and help him gently cleanse the world of magical corruption, all while building a home and enjoying peaceful moments of exploration.
